# Inherited Cordis API

The framework `ctx` members and events every plugin sees beyond the harness tier — first-party framework source ([framework/README.md](../../framework/README.md)), summarized tersely so the harness pages stay focused on repository-owned vocabulary. Detailed Context, Fiber, Registry, and Service APIs are generated in [context.md](context.md), [fiber.md](fiber.md), [registry.md](registry.md), and [service.md](service.md); the event-dispatch methods in [events.md](events.md).

This file was originally generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts`. That script and its `verify-cordis-catalog` freshness check no longer exist, so this page is maintained by hand and must be updated alongside the code it describes. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and include the original source JSDoc immediately before each event or service method. doc-typecheck skips these bare declaration fragments; type names in a signature link to the page that documents them.

## Inherited `ctx` members (cordis core + loader/hmr/timer)

- `ctx.on / ctx.once` — Register an event listener (disposable). ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `ctx.emit / ctx.parallel / ctx.serial / ctx.bail / ctx.waterfall` — Dispatch an event (sync / awaited / first-bail / short-circuit chain). ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `ctx.plugin / ctx.inject` — Load a plugin / declare required services. ([`framework/cordis/src/registry.js:186`](../../framework/cordis/src/registry.js))
- `ctx.effect` — Register a disposable side effect tied to the fiber. ([`framework/cordis/src/fiber.js:367`](../../framework/cordis/src/fiber.js))
- `ctx.get / ctx.set / ctx.provide / ctx.accessor / ctx.mixin` — Low-level service-store access and binding. ([`framework/cordis/src/reflect.js:133`](../../framework/cordis/src/reflect.js))
- `ctx.extend / ctx.isolate / ctx.intercept` — Derive a child context (scoped services / isolation / interception). ([`framework/cordis/src/context.js:72`](../../framework/cordis/src/context.js))
- `ctx.root / ctx.scope / ctx.fiber / ctx.registry / ctx.reflect / ctx.events / ctx.logger` — Ambient handles onto the running context graph. ([`framework/cordis/src/context.js:15`](../../framework/cordis/src/context.js))
- `ctx.timer (+ interval / timeout / throttle / debounce)` — Disposable timer helpers. The `timer` key is provided at runtime; the four supported helpers are mixed onto ctx directly (mixed via `ctx.mixin`). ([`framework/timer/src/index.js:4`](../../framework/timer/src/index.js))
- `ctx.loader` — The config Loader that booted the app (present under the loader). ([`framework/loader/src/index.js:28`](../../framework/loader/src/index.js))
- `ctx.hmr` — The hot-module-reload watcher (present under the hmr plugin). ([`framework/hmr/src/index.js:51`](../../framework/hmr/src/index.js))

## Inherited events (cordis core + loader/hmr/timer)

- `internal/plugin` — A plugin fiber was created. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/status` — A fiber changed lifecycle state. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/service` — Interception hook for a service binding (no core producer). ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/update` — Waterfall: a fiber config update is being applied. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/get` — Waterfall: a service is being read from the store. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/set` — Waterfall: a service is being written to the store. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/listener` — A listener was registered. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `internal/dispatch` — An event is being dispatched to listeners. ([`framework/cordis/src/events.js`](../../framework/cordis/src/events.js))
- `hmr/change` — A watched source file changed on disk. ([`framework/hmr/src/index.js`](../../framework/hmr/src/index.js))
- `hmr/reload` — Plugins are being reloaded after a change. ([`framework/hmr/src/index.js`](../../framework/hmr/src/index.js))
- `exit` — The process is exiting on a signal. ([`framework/loader/src/index.js`](../../framework/loader/src/index.js))
- `loader/config-update` — The loader config tree changed. ([`framework/include/src/index.js:336`](../../framework/include/src/index.js))
- `loader/entry-init` — A config entry is being initialized. ([`framework/loader/src/config/entry.js`](../../framework/loader/src/config/entry.js))
- `loader/partial-dispose` — An entry is being partially disposed on reload. ([`framework/loader/src/config/entry.js`](../../framework/loader/src/config/entry.js))
- `loader/patch-context` — A context is being patched during a reload. ([`framework/loader/src/config/entry.js`](../../framework/loader/src/config/entry.js))
